tasks.short: Consult and provide surgical assistance to colleagues

steps.what: Read the actual pediatric patient's relevant record and locate the consultation question, imaging and operative context
Discuss the actual pediatric surgical question with the other physician or surgeon and agree what assistance is needed
outputs: specific proposed surgical assistance and consultation findings

steps.what: Confirm the exact requested assistance and immediate operative readiness under the actual lead surgeon's responsibility
inputs: specific proposed surgical assistance and consultation findings
outputs: current authorization for specific surgical assistance

steps.what: Provide the actual requested hands-on surgical assistance and coordinate continuously with the operating surgeon
inputs: specific proposed surgical assistance and consultation findings
current authorization for specific surgical assistance
outputs: actual surgical assistance performed and observed outcome

steps.what: Write and correct the actual consultation and assistance note used by the treating team, including observed findings and unresolved issues
inputs: specific proposed surgical assistance and consultation findings
actual surgical assistance performed and observed outcome
outputs: checked working consultation and assistance note

loop.purpose: Suggest a note from the surgeon's actual factual account
loop.input: Clinician-entered consultation, performed-assistance and outcome facts
loop.output: Draft note with source pointers and explicit missing fields
loop.check: Surgeon checks every finding, action, timing, patient reference and unresolved issue against actual events and removes unsupported text
loop.stop: Two drafts; remaining omissions or errors are corrected manually within retained writing and counted repair
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed note template handles headings, but expressing the actual episode requires semantic drafting

steps.what: Save the ordinary factual working note in the same patient record
inputs: checked working consultation and assistance note
outputs: saved working consultation and assistance note

tasks.design: Use patient-linked references and a bounded note-drafting helper in {OTHER}, the patient-record, imaging and operative documentation environment. Keep actual consultation, current operative authority and hands-on assistance fully human; the surgeon supplies the factual account and checks the note.
tasks.previous_blocker: Consultation preparation can repeat record navigation and the actual assistance episode must be written up for the treating team.
tasks.enabler_now: Native patient links and fact-bound note suggestions support those specific documentation actions.
tasks.still_hard: Patient context, live operative conditions and coordination require direct clinical judgment and physical skill.
tasks.human_edge: The surgeon understands the actual patient and recognizes clinically significant findings and changes.

ambition.what: No automated diagnosis, treatment choice, operative command or surgical action.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: patient-linked references and bounded factual note drafting can support documentation while pediatric surgical consultation and assistance remain human.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual consultation and hands-on assistance, not just paperwork. The note is an actual clinical record used by the treating team, not a new trailing report. It follows the performed assistance.
s1 counts actual patient/context reading and removes1.5 of15 navigation units, retaining13.5. Native existing record views earn zero new gain.

s2 captures actual consultation findings, s4 supplies actual performed-assistance/outcome facts and s5 includes clinician entry of the factual account; no audio recording, transcript or free clean episode feed is presumed.

s3 represents the actual operating lead's existing responsibility and immediate request for the specific assistance, not a new supervisor paperwork approval. a1 gates only that real physical action; any changed request or conditions require renewed live confirmation.
s5 retains11.4 of19 writing/checking units and upkeep includes1 extra manual failed-draft correction unit. Test native note templates first; existing text reuse earns zero new gain.

Save1 is negligible ordinary same-system persistence, fully retained and ungated, without author self-approval. A formal clinical attestation, order, referral or external note dispatch requires its actual authority and separate final-version action. Shares are unmeasured work estimates, not clinical guidance.
research_questions: Can factual note drafting fit within retained clinician entry and checking without omitting significant events?

already_counted.description: Actual patient/context reading, consultation, full physical assistance and retained factual note entry/checking remain counted.
Actual operating lead's immediate responsibility remains counted outside focal labour.

incremental.description: Maintain patient-reference/note checks1; manually correct failed drafts1.

approvals.approved_version: Specific assistance discussed in s2 and confirmed for actual current operative conditions in s3; changed requests or conditions require renewed live confirmation.

Low: an unusual operative episode lacks compatible note structure, retaining18 of19 note units and14.5 of15 navigation units;1.5/95*100 is below2 upkeep, net clamped0. Actual consultation and physical assistance remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Pediatric surgical judgment and actual hands-on assistance remain human while specific record navigation and factual note drafting can shrink.
reach: Work with the actual operating team and patient-record staff on episode provenance and note checks.
role.ambitious_version: A surgeon who documents actual consultation and assistance with less repeated writing while preserving live clinical responsibility and physical care.
